caption: A transparent, slightly tapered drinking glass with a thick solid-blue base rests centered on horizontal weathered wooden slats. A small pool of clear liquid sits in the bottom of the glass, and a few tiny droplets cling to the inner wall above the liquid line. The bright blue base shows a strong white sun-refraction highlight at its middle. Behind the glass, an out-of-focus grassy field is topped by a blurred light-colored fence or railing. Across the visible time, the glass, droplets, liquid line, and soft background appear essentially unchanged; no pouring or obvious movement is apparent.
